newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas mostly steady, 100 lots traded.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas mostly steady, 100 lots traded.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures ended the day little changed and the only business done was 50 lots traded on each of October and November, slightly weaker than on Wednesday, traders said.
October and November traded at 12.20 and 13.30 pence per therm, respectively 0.1 and 0.05 pence per therm down on the day, and all of the other months were notionally unchanged.
Traders in the physical markets said that while prompt prices had softened slightly, most of the months traded were stable.
Gas was heard traded at the National Balance Point for the fourth quarter of the year at 13.45 pence per therm, unchanged from Wednesday.
Transco was expected to announce a tender on Friday to sell gas in the summer months but dealers said this was not having an immediate impact on prices because it was already widely known.
